title: Four Pontotoc volleyball players earn Class 5A academic all-region honors
excerpt: Meredith Farley, Gracie Kuykendall, A’mia Mabry and Tara Wilburn represent Pontotoc on the Region 1 academic list.

facts.statement: Three seniors and a junior from Pontotoc’s volleyball team earned academic all-region honors this fall. Pontotoc Athletics named Meredith Farley, Gracie Kuykendall, A’mia Mabry and Tara Wilburn in its announcement Thursday.
facts.evidence: Read all four names directly from the school’s Region 1 award graphic. Matched each to the current roster, using the school’s spelling of A’mia.
facts.statistics: Four athletes; three seniors and one junior.
facts.date_context: School announcement Nov. 19, 2026, following the fall varsity season.
facts.identities: Pontotoc varsity volleyball, the four named honorees and Class 5A Region 1.

facts.statement: Mabry, the junior, wore No. 2. Farley wore No. 4, Kuykendall No. 7 and Wilburn No. 1. Kuykendall played libero and defensive specialist, and Wilburn was listed as a setter and defensive specialist.
facts.evidence: Current varsity roster records jersey numbers, class and positions for all four.
facts.date_context: School announcement Nov. 19, 2026, following the fall varsity season.

facts.statement: The Class 5A Region 1 announcement named 16 players, four apiece from Pontotoc, Caledonia, New Hope and Lafayette. Caledonia was also Pontotoc’s final playoff opponent. The Warriors swept Cleveland Central on Oct. 6 before losing in three sets at Caledonia on Oct. 8. They finished 21–8 overall and 7–3 in the district.

paragraphs.text: Three seniors and a junior from Pontotoc’s volleyball team earned academic all-region honors this fall. Pontotoc Athletics named Meredith Farley, Gracie Kuykendall, A’mia Mabry and Tara Wilburn in its announcement Thursday.
Mabry, the junior, wore No. 2. Farley wore No. 4, Kuykendall No. 7 and Wilburn No. 1. Kuykendall played libero and defensive specialist, and Wilburn was listed as a setter and defensive specialist.

The Class 5A Region 1 announcement named 16 players, four apiece from Pontotoc, Caledonia, New Hope and Lafayette. Caledonia was also Pontotoc’s final playoff opponent. The Warriors swept Cleveland Central on Oct. 6 before losing in three sets at Caledonia on Oct. 8. They finished 21–8 overall and 7–3 in the district.
